summary: Operators using the RPKI issue Route Origin Authorizations (ROAs) to say which autonomous systems may originate BGP routes for their address blocks. This best-practice document discusses operational problems when one ROA lists several prefixes. It recommends that each ROA contain just one IP prefix.

eli5.summary: If one permission slip covers many things and one of them goes wrong, the whole slip stops working. This advice says to use one slip per thing, so a problem hurts less.

questions: should a roa contain multiple prefixes
